paragraphs: He reported in the name of Rav, Menachot 35b. Dikdukei Soferim has bar Madrakhi; the Rosh reads bar Mari.[^1]

notes.text: אמר רב is the heading figure’s reporting formula, not an unrelated Rav statement. לה: gives Menachot 35b under the colon convention, without independent named-edition verification. Dikdukei Soferim and Rosh are contextual work/commentator labels; their readings remain Hyman’s attributions. Supplied מדרכי is Madrakhi, not silently transposed to מרדכי/Mordechai from older machine text. Bidri, Madrakhi and Mari remain distinct forms. Rav is full; Shmuel has no added title.
